create_siren_network: create a SIREN neural network with sine activations and specified layer widths for continuous function regression
build_basis_encoding: build a Basis module with powersine or gauss smearing to encode input features for graph neural networks
create_spherical_smearing: create a SphericalSmearing module to compute real spherical harmonics from normalized 3D direction vectors
build_fourier_smearing: build a FourierSmearing module to encode input features using linear frequency sine or cosine basis functions
create_gaussian_smearing: create a GaussianSmearing module to encode input features using Gaussian radial basis functions over a specified range
